name: monday.com
description: Read boards and items, create and update items, post updates and build boards in monday.com through monday.com's hosted MCP server. Sign in with your monday.com account.
examples: Show the items on my "Product roadmap" board whose status is Stuck, with their owners.
Add an item "Update pricing page" to the "This week" group of the Marketing board.
Set the status of "Q4 launch" on the Roadmap board to Done and post an update saying it shipped.

zh-CN.name: monday.com
zh-CN.description: 通过 monday.com 官方托管的 MCP 服务读取看板与条目、创建和更新条目、发布动态并搭建看板。用 monday.com 账号登录。
examples: 列出“Product roadmap”看板上状态为 Stuck 的条目，以及各自的负责人。
在 Marketing 看板的“This week”分组里新增条目“更新定价页”。
把 Roadmap 看板上“Q4 launch”的状态改为 Done，并发一条动态说明已上线。
